title: 第15章 武判官出手-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    听完吴姜的话，武判官脸上露出了然的神色，缓缓开口说道：“你说的这个红衣厉鬼，日夜游神早就察觉到她的踪迹了。只是这女鬼十分狡猾，身上似乎有什么遮蔽气息的法器，每次我们派阴差前去收服，她都能立刻隐藏自己的气息，消失得无影无踪，我们搜寻了许久，都没能找到她的下落，只能暂时搁置。”

    吴姜恍然大悟，心里的疑惑终于解开了——他就说，这女鬼在王家盘桓了这么久，城隍庙怎么会一直不出手。

    武判官顿了顿，又说道：“如今城隍庙正处于新老城隍交替的时期，麾下不少阴差，趁着新城隍未到任，都申请了轮回转世，导致人手十分有限；日夜游神又有其他公务在身，分身乏术，这事就一直拖到了现在。没想到，这次居然被你碰到了，还逼得她现身了。”

    吴姜眼睛一亮，连忙拱手说道：“大人，若是我能想办法，将那女鬼引出来，让她无法躲藏，不知道大人能不能出手，将她收服？”

    武判官眼神一凝，斩钉截铁地说道：“只要她敢露面，必能将她捉拿归案！”

    吴姜心中一喜，连忙再次拱手道谢：“多谢判官大人出手相助！太好了，有大人这句话，我就放心了！引诱女鬼现身的事情，就交给我，我一定想办法，让她无法逃脱！”

    紧接着，吴姜又将自己的计划说了一遍。

    武判官听完，点了点头，他站起身，对着殿门外大喝一声：“来人！”

    话音刚落，四个身着黑色阴差制服、身材高大、神色威严的阴差，快步从殿外走了进来，对着武判官拱手行礼，声音洪亮：“属下在！”

    “随本判官，前往王家别墅，收服厉鬼，不得有误！”武判官语气威严地吩咐道，周身的肃杀之气再次弥漫开来。

    “是！”四个阴差齐声应道，声音震耳欲聋，恭敬地站在一旁，等候吩咐。

    武判官不再耽搁，率先朝着殿门外走去，吴姜和四个阴差紧随其后。

    一行六人，身形一晃，瞬间化作五道残影，快速冲出城隍庙，朝着王家别墅的方向飘去。

    凭借着阴魂的速度，没过多久，六人就抵达了王家别墅。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

After listening to Wu Jiang’s words, Judge Wu showed a look of understanding on his face and said slowly: “The ghost in red clothes you are talking about has been noticed by the day and night wandering gods for a long time. It’s just that this female ghost is very cunning, and she seems to have some magic weapon that can mask her breath. Every time we send an undercover agent to subdue her, she can immediately hide her breath and disappear without a trace. We have searched for a long time, but we have not been able to find her whereabouts, so we can only put it aside for the time being.”

Wu Jiang suddenly realized, and the doubts in his heart were finally solved - he said, this female ghost has been lingering in the Wang family for so long, how come the Chenghuang Temple has not taken action.

Judge Wu paused and then said: "Now the City God's Temple is in the period of alternation between the old and new City God. There are many shady people under his command who have applied for reincarnation before the new City God took office, resulting in very limited manpower. The God of Day and Night has other official duties and is too busy to do anything, so this matter has been dragged on until now. I didn't expect that you actually encountered me this time and forced her to show up."

Wu Jiang’s eyes lit up and he quickly raised his hands and said, “Sir, if I can think of a way to lure the female ghost out so that she can’t hide, I wonder if I can take action and subdue her?”

Judge Wu’s eyes narrowed and he said decisively: “As long as she dares to show up, she will be caught and brought to justice!”

Wu Jiang was overjoyed, and hurriedly handed over his hands again to express his thanks: "Thank you, Lord Judge, for your help! That's great. With your words, I feel relieved! Leave the matter of luring the female ghost to me, and I will definitely find a way to prevent her from escaping!"

Immediately afterwards, Wu Jiang explained his plan again.

After hearing this, Judge Wu nodded. He stood up and shouted to the door of the palace: "Come here!"

As soon as he finished speaking, four tall and dignified Yinzai wearing black Yinzai uniforms walked in quickly from outside the palace, saluted Judge Wu with their hands raised, and said in a loud voice, "My subordinates are here!"

"Follow this judge to the Wang family villa and subdue the evil ghosts without any mistakes!" Judge Wu ordered in a majestic tone, and the murderous aura around him once again filled the air.

"Yes!" The four undercover men responded in unison, their voices deafening, standing aside respectfully, waiting for instructions.

Judge Wu did not delay any longer and took the lead to walk towards the door of the palace, followed closely by Wu Jiang and the four Yin Chai.

A group of six people swayed and instantly turned into five afterimages. They quickly rushed out of the Chenghuang Temple and floated towards the Wang family villa.

With the speed of Yinhun, it didn’t take long for the six of them to arrive at the Wang family villa.

title_en: Chapter 15 Judge Wu takes action - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out I am the Nth generation of God"
